title: Writing Short Messages
introduction: Write a short greeting, thank-you note or message using a model. Begin with a capital letter and use clear spacing.
definition: Write a short greeting, thank-you note or message using a model. Begin with a capital letter and use clear spacing.
rules: Write a short greeting, thank-you note or message using a model. Begin with a capital letter and use clear spacing.

examples.question: Complete a birthday greeting: Happy ___!
steps: Read the prompt and choose the word that fits.

examples.question: Complete a thank-you note: Thank ___, Mum.
steps: Read the prompt and choose the word that fits.

exercises.question: Complete a birthday greeting: Happy ___!
exercises.solution: Use the greeting that celebrates someone's birthday.

exercises.question: Complete a thank-you note: Thank ___, Mum.
exercises.solution: Thank you is the usual expression of gratitude.

exercises.question: Complete a note: Dear Ben, please bring your ___. (book or books; use one book)
exercises.solution: The instruction asks for one item, so use the singular noun.

exercises.question: Complete a farewell message: See you ___. (tomorrow or yesterday)
exercises.solution: Tomorrow refers to the day after today; yesterday is in the past.

exercises.question: Complete a greeting: Good ___! (early in the day)
exercises.solution: Use the greeting for the early part of the day.

summary: Write a short greeting, thank-you note or message using a model. Begin with a capital letter and use clear spacing.
